goal: Run one bounded externally anchored software-repair trial against an exact public upstream repository commit and its official regression tests. Deterministically select a recent unresolved reproducible defect without reading a solution patch, freeze the task and source commit before implementation, produce a minimal candidate patch, and have an isolated GitHub Actions job apply it and run the upstream tests.

a deterministic selector over public repositories with permissive licenses, reproducible test instructions, recent unresolved bug reports, and no prior appearance in this Run or Episode
the exact selected issue URL, immutable upstream commit SHA, license/provenance receipt, and a pre-implementation contamination audit
an isolated GitHub Actions runner that clones only the frozen upstream commit, applies the candidate patch, and runs the upstream official regression and focused tests

scope: Read-only public upstream source and issue metadata plus isolated temporary checkouts and O repository evidence artifacts. No upstream write, comment, fork mutation, release, deployment, credential use, Candidate activation, provider/production routing change, or AGI/completion claim.
success_conditions: the deterministic selector yields exactly one eligible previously unseen external task and freezes its issue plus exact upstream commit before repair work
the baseline reproduces the reported defect using upstream-owned tests or an issue-derived focused reproducer that is fixed before patch generation
the candidate patch is minimal, applies cleanly, makes the focused reproduction pass, and preserves the defined upstream regression suite with no network or provenance drift
all selection, contamination, patch, test, timing, and resource receipts replay deterministically and remain bound to the exact external commit
the result is reported only as one bounded external software-repair observation; task/user/upper and AGI claims remain separately evaluated
